title: CB1-F: pre-IF-H2 ladder universe (events 2024-01..2025-05), rung prices and trades (chunked <=150 min)
outputs: data-dumps/research_lab/history/h5_cb1_ladders/{events,ladders}.jsonl.gz, probe.json, prices/, trades/, progress.jsonl, request_clock.json, manifest.json
notes: Replaces q0017_h5_cb1_ladders_fetch, which was falsely marked done without producing ladders: a missing IF-H2 ladder file (FileNotFoundError, an OSError) was mapped to a disk_budget stop and exited 0. Fixed (missing inputs now fail loudly); if_h2 restored on the host from release data-20261013-research-lab. Same argv and parameters as q0017 (no scientific change). | Probe of 20 seeded rungs first; exits 0 with status probe_failed if fewer than 80% have prices (B1/B2 not testable). The IF-H2 ladder file defaults to data-dumps/research_lab/if_h2/ladders.jsonl.gz and must exist on the host (fails loudly otherwise). Wall time is dominated by the hourly price windows; yields to the collector. | Fixes 1 (window union independent of close time) and 2 (trades capped at T_fetch, no chunk after T_seal 2026-10-22T00:00Z) landed; gated by q0033_h5_fix_gate.
